theater_event_25_03_11_001:
The "Hunter" showed up again!
Heard he took out a bunch of Evilus!
theater_event_25_03_11_002:
He protected the craftsmen in the industrial
district! My husband says he saved him too!
theater_event_25_03_11_003:
He's like a real hero of justice! It's like
there's a whole extra Astraea Familia! But...
who on earth is he?
theater_event_25_03_11_004: (—I had a bad feeling. No... a hunch.)
theater_event_25_03_11_006:
(Coincidence? Really? Can I keep fooling
myself? If I'm wrong, that's fine!)
theater_event_25_03_11_007:
(I'll find "him" goofing off, sag with relief,
get mad, make him flail... and then we'll
laugh together. That's all I want...!)
theater_event_25_03_11_008:
...A friend of mine saw him. Says he's human.
But he shows up in the city AND the Dungeon...
when does he even rest?
theater_event_25_03_11_009:
He fights alone, nonstop, right?
...Is he some kind of monster?
theater_event_25_03_11_010:
I mean, he's saving us, and I'm grateful...
but at this rate, won't he get himself killed...?
theater_event_25_03_11_012:
(I have to find him, fast!
I have to find him and make sure...!)
theater_event_25_03_11_013:
Hey, it's the Evilus! They're in the industrial
district! And... the "Hunter" might be there too!
theater_event_25_03_11_022:
...So I heard. He defended the magic-stone
products factory a second time.
theater_event_25_03_11_023:
Then did you hear he flattened one of
the Alecto Familia's executives?
theater_event_25_03_11_024:
What...?! The most vicious faction of the Evilus?!
Is that true?!
theater_event_25_03_11_025:
It's a fact. He refused to kill—he just
incapacitated him. The executive is now
locked up by the Guild.
theater_event_25_03_11_026:
He wrecked their plans, so those broken elves...
the Dis Sisters are supposedly livid.
theater_event_25_03_11_027:
So the rumors that he's as strong as
a first-tier adventurer... are true?
theater_event_25_03_11_028:
The people are hailing him as
a "hero of justice."
theater_event_25_03_11_029:
And though it's not an adventurer's title...
some are calling him the "Jester."
theater_event_25_03_11_030:
Jester... a clown?
Could he be tied to the Loki Familia?
theater_event_25_03_11_031:
His moves seem to line up with Braver's operations.
So people are saying they might secretly
be working together.
theater_event_25_03_11_032:
Who knows. From the outside, looks to me like
that scheming hero's just using him on his own.
theater_event_25_03_11_033:
...And the Jester's identity?
Do we still know nothing?
theater_event_25_03_11_034:
Beats me. Apparently he wears a mask,
like a certain Gale we know.
We haven't laid eyes on him yet, either...
theater_event_25_03_11_035: But I'm told he's human, and male.
theater_event_25_03_11_037: Is he truly... unconnected to Al?
theater_event_25_03_11_038:
The Jester started appearing the very day he
disappeared! How can we NOT suspect a link?!
theater_event_25_03_11_039:
...Silence. You're noisy.
Why get so worked up over a hypothesis?
theater_event_25_03_11_040:
Kaguya...!
Aren't YOU the one hiding something?!
theater_event_25_03_11_041:
The night Al vanished, you were the last
one to speak with him!
theater_event_25_03_11_042:
...A greenhorn playing detective? Don't make
me laugh. Keep up these tiresome suspicions
and I'll cut you down.
theater_event_25_03_11_043:
Very well! And when I win,
you'll spit out everything you know!
theater_event_25_03_11_044:
Oi, take it outside, you two.
Geez, Ryu and Kaguya are both all shook up.
theater_event_25_03_11_046:
I don't know anything. But I'm sure of it.
The Jester is Al.
theater_event_25_03_11_048:
I don't know what Al's after.
But it makes me so sad he didn't lean on us...
theater_event_25_03_11_053: Maybe... Al is running out of time.
theater_event_25_03_12_002:
Hah, hah...!
They even sent out tamed monsters...
theater_event_25_03_12_003:
It's no good, I can't take Knossos alone...!
I have no choice... but to retreat.
theater_event_25_03_12_004:
I really can't be like Mr. Finn...
I can't beat enemies like Ms. Ais!
theater_event_25_03_12_005:
No matter how much I know about the future,
I can't put it to good use...!
theater_event_25_03_12_006: (Should I have gone to Mr. Finn from the start?)
theater_event_25_03_12_007:
(But if I approach him now, he'll definitely
be suspicious! Other adventurers too!
We'd never be real allies!)
theater_event_25_03_12_008:
I've told Lady Astraea about the future,
and she should be sharing it with Lady Loki
and the others...
theater_event_25_03_12_009:
Besides, Mr. Finn would just use me for his own
plans! So I'll do what only I can do...!
theater_event_25_03_12_010:
Rain...
I need... to rest a little...
theater_event_25_03_12_011: (The Rudra Familia is still out there...)
theater_event_25_03_12_014:
(Sleepy! So sleepy!! But I can't sleep...!
Not until "that god" finds me, at least...!)
theater_event_25_03_12_015:
Hey there. You're the Jester everyone's
talking about?
theater_event_25_03_12_017:
Finally caught your trail.
I've been dying to meet you, my dear Jester.
theater_event_25_03_12_018: Or... should I call you an "irregular"?
theater_event_25_03_12_020:
Oh, you know who I am.
That makes this easier.
theater_event_25_03_12_021:
...Just who are you, stirring up
Orario like this?
theater_event_25_03_12_024:
Because I wanted you to find me, Lord Hermes...
I wanted to "negotiate" with you...
theater_event_25_03_12_025:
Strange thing to say.
Then why not just come see me yourself?
theater_event_25_03_12_026:
If I'd visited you, or even if Lady Astraea
pulled strings... you'd have suspected me.
It would've taken too long to meet.
theater_event_25_03_12_028:
...No, wait.
What are those awful bags under your eyes?
How long since you've slept?
theater_event_25_03_12_029:
Once it got past two weeks...
I stopped counting...
theater_event_25_03_12_031:
Even if you are a first-tier adventurer,
that'll kill you! Why won't you sleep?
theater_event_25_03_12_034:
I can tell for sure now, Lord Hermes.
If I fall asleep, I'll be thrown out of here.
theater_event_25_03_12_035:
The "dream" will be over...
So no matter how much time I had,
it was never enough...
theater_event_25_03_12_036:
...Let me ask again.
Just who are you?
theater_event_25_03_12_039: I came from seven years in the future...
theater_event_25_03_12_040:
...I see. So your brutal string of heroics
came from knowing the future.
theater_event_25_03_12_041:
All to save little Alise and her friends...
I see, I see.
theater_event_25_03_12_044: ...You gods can tell if we're lying.
theater_event_25_03_12_045: Sure can. And you're not lying one bit.
theater_event_25_03_12_046:
But you could be a "madman" who's convinced
himself he's perfectly sane.
theater_event_25_03_12_047:
Or someone who's been hypnotized into
believing it, and is being puppeted.
theater_event_25_03_12_049:
As long as that's even slightly possible,
I can't come to the table.
theater_event_25_03_12_050:
If you want me at the table... you'll need
hard "proof." Don't you think, Jester?
theater_event_25_03_12_053: Please wait... I'll take my shirt off...
theater_event_25_03_12_054:
Whoa, whoa, what're you doing?
A guy stripping is NOT my thing—!!
theater_event_25_03_12_055: Can you see, Lord Hermes... my back...?
theater_event_25_03_12_058: And on top of that... the "Luck" ability?
theater_event_25_03_12_060:
Oh, damn, how delightful!
A god, put completely in his place!
theater_event_25_03_12_061: You're the best, Jester! No—Bell Cranel!!
theater_event_25_03_12_063:
I sure do! Not after proof like that!
So? What do you want me to do?
theater_event_25_03_12_064:
From what you've said, you're out of time,
right? Let's wrap this deal up fast.
theater_event_25_03_12_066:
...Are you serious?
You want ME to do that?
theater_event_25_03_12_067:
I'm sorry—please, I'm begging you...
In exchange, I'll give you this...
theater_event_25_03_12_069:
A "Daedalus Orb"... It's a key to Knossos,
where the Evilus are hiding.
theater_event_25_03_12_071: I could only steal one from the enemy...
theater_event_25_03_12_072:
Everything else, I told Lady Astraea...
The "Great Feud," and what comes after...
you should all be able to handle it...
theater_event_25_03_12_073:
...All right. On the name of Hermes, I'll
answer your devotion. I'll bring you
what you ordered, no matter what.
theater_event_25_03_12_074:
Thank goodness...
Then please, give it to "her"...
theater_event_25_03_12_075:
No.
You'll give it to "her" with your own hands.
theater_event_25_03_12_077:
You think she'd keep a gift from me
with her at all times?
theater_event_25_03_12_078:
It's meaningless unless it's from you.
This is your ego, your justice,
and you have to see it through.
theater_event_25_03_12_079:
So don't disappear before I get back,
Bell Cranel.
theater_event_25_03_13_002:
Where are you?! Lord Hermes told me!
He said you were here!
theater_event_25_03_13_004:
Al! Wait... what's happening to you?!
Your body... it's fading!
theater_event_25_03_13_005:
I can't stay awake anymore...
The "dream"... is ending...
theater_event_25_03_13_006:
What are you saying...?
I don't understand, Al!
theater_event_25_03_13_009:
Please... keep it with you, always...
It's the one thing I'll ever ask of you...
theater_event_25_03_13_010: It'll protect you... I'm sure of it...
theater_event_25_03_13_012:
...Geez, what am I gonna do with you?
I'm pretty popular, you know?
theater_event_25_03_13_013: Yes... Because you're beautiful, Ms. Ardee...
theater_event_25_03_13_014:
If I take a present from a boy,
my big sister's gonna scold me.
theater_event_25_03_13_016:
—Okay.
I'll keep it forever, your present!
theater_event_25_03_13_017: So... we'll meet again, right, Al?!
theater_event_25_03_13_020:
We finally found him, but...
what the hell is going on here?!
theater_event_25_03_13_021: His body... it's like a phantom of light...!
theater_event_25_03_13_023:
...Ms. Alise, Ms. Kaguya, Ms. Lyra...
I'm so glad I met you all...
theater_event_25_03_13_027:
"Ms. Ryu" shared her justice with me...
So you too... someday, I know you'll
find your way to justice...
theater_event_25_03_13_030:
Before Ryu and the others, a lone boy—
the Hunter, the "Jester"—vanished
as if none of it had ever happened.
theater_event_25_03_13_031:
He changed the fates of many and saved many
lives, leaving it all behind in the name
of his justice—his ego.
theater_event_25_03_13_032: And so ends the tale of the "Jester"—
theater_event_25_03_13_034:
It seems "he" has caught the fancy of
mindless Chaos, completely and utterly.
theater_event_25_03_13_035:
The "Jester's" curtain call is still
a long way off————
theater_event_25_04_01_001:
No luck.
Truly, no luck at all.
theater_event_25_04_01_002:
No. In a sense, he's luckier than anyone.
Precisely because of that luck, Chaos was
enchanted by him and dragged him in.
theater_event_25_04_01_003: Can you cross it? This river of hell?
theater_event_25_04_01_004: Can you overcome it? One more holy war?
theater_event_25_04_01_005:
I can't wait for an answer. Sorry.
So let's begin—
theater_event_25_04_01_006:
A "reprise" of history, woven in
another time and place.
theater_event_25_04_01_014:
Get up! Run!
There are adventurers down this road!
theater_event_25_04_01_017:
(When is this? What happened to me? I said
goodbye to Ms. Ryu and the others, but
I'm still in the "dream"?!)
theater_event_25_04_01_018:
I don't know! I don't know anything!
But still—I'm done hearing people scream!!
theater_event_25_04_01_020:
The Great Feud—the decisive battle of good
and evil, also called the "Seven Days of Death."
I know of no hell worse than that.
theater_event_25_04_01_021:
The enemy: the Evilus, led by "Absolute Evil."
Facing them: every force in Orario.
theater_event_25_04_01_022:
Countless lives were lost on both sides,
and the city of heroes truly came close
to falling back then—
theater_event_25_04_01_023:
If this is the "Great Feud" Ms. Ryu told me about!
If it's a hell where so many people die!
theater_event_25_04_01_024:
Then I have to fight! Fight and fight...
and save as many people as I can!!
theater_event_25_04_01_026:
Our losses are growing...?!
What—what's going on?!
theater_event_25_04_01_027:
R-robe and a mask! Robe and a mask!!
No, it's not Gale! It's—it's—!!
theater_event_25_04_01_029:
No way, the Jester is alive...?!
The guy who vanished without a trace
three months ago...?!
theater_event_25_04_01_030:
Please, I beg of you!
Lend us your strength, so that the divine
will of our "Absolute Evil" may be done...!
theater_event_25_04_01_033:
I can move...! And I'm not sleepy!
My head's as clear as if I'd slept
a full ten hours!!
theater_event_25_04_01_034: Like this, I can save everyone————
theater_event_25_04_01_036: ————So you're the source of the noise.
theater_event_25_04_01_037:
The curtain has risen.
You are the irregular.
theater_event_25_04_01_038:
Chaos on a whim casts dice so wild not even
the gods intend them. Or perhaps it's fate—
if he has truly descended onto this stage.
theater_event_25_04_01_039:
Sing, Etranger. Dance for us, Jester.
Let the audience who wished for "what if"
hear an intertwining gospel.
theater_event_25_04_01_041:
Here is a great Record,
apart from the stars'—.
theater_event_25_04_02_002:
Everything south of Central Park is destroyed!
The north is still holding! The enemy is
the Alecto and the Apate Familia!
theater_event_25_04_02_003:
Ever since the man in armor—Zeus Familia's
"Gluttony"—defeated the Warlord, morale
has been in free fall!
theater_event_25_04_02_004:
(Zeus's Level 7! The former strongest, a true
enemy now...! Then the other most fearsome—
Hera's familia—may come as well...!)
theater_event_25_04_02_005:
They've seized control of the battlefield...!
So this is your "trump card," Evilus! Valletta!
theater_event_25_04_02_006:
—R-report! Signs of a counterattack in the
west! An unknown force is ambushing an enemy
unit from behind—"just one person"...!
theater_event_25_04_02_007:
M-my memory's all jumbled... it just came
back to me... but that look—it's the "Hunter"!
It's the Jester!!
theater_event_25_04_02_008:
(...! The "Hunter" is alive!
According to Loki, we couldn't count
on him anymore...)
theater_event_25_04_02_009:
And... he's now engaged enemy reinforcements!
From the Hera Familia—Alfia, the "Silence"!!
theater_event_25_04_02_010:
(...What is this woman? No openings. No—
she's too QUIET. Like the whole world is
being dragged into her...!)
theater_event_25_04_02_011:
(My blood's churning! My heart's pounding!
She's too strong!! Way stronger than me!
...So why won't she make a move?)
theater_event_25_04_02_014:
Lie to me once more and I'll punch
a hole clean through you.
theater_event_25_04_02_016:
There's no next time.
...What is your true name?
theater_event_25_04_02_021:
A dream? An illusion? No. You truly "exist"
here. Then is this the work of some rotten
god who presides over comedy?
theater_event_25_04_02_022:
—Very well. I'll dance.
And if there's some idiotic script,
I'll crush it underfoot.
theater_event_25_04_02_027:
Which are you?
Order or chaos? Justice or evil?
theater_event_25_04_02_028:
Hngh...?
I'll help the people who are hurt!
theater_event_25_04_02_029:
Then come. I have made a pact with a god
as "evil." I am violence and cruelty
incarnate—your very opposite.
theater_event_25_04_02_030:
...!! No matter how strong you are,
I'll stop you! I won't let anyone else die!!
theater_event_25_04_02_031:
You're noisy. Stop shrieking. Only "strength
with will" may roar—not "will without strength."
theater_event_25_04_02_032: ————Let me teach you a hero's manners, boy!!
theater_event_25_04_03_001:
Too straightforward.
Are you a rabbit?
theater_event_25_04_03_003:
A move like that won't cut a dragon.
This is how you swing a blade.
theater_event_25_04_03_005:
Was that meant to be a feint?
A child's trick, more like. Not even
worth a sigh.
theater_event_25_04_03_007:
What good is putting distance between us,
fool? Does this withered-twig body look
like a "vanguard" to you?
theater_event_25_04_03_009:
Ngh... ghhhh...!
She's too... strong...!! Way more than
I thought...!!
theater_event_25_04_03_010:
The only thing you beat me in is casting speed...
And you dared shriek that you'd "stop" me, boy?
theater_event_25_04_03_012:
Why won't you finish it...? You could blow
me away in an instant! So... are you just
toying with me?!
theater_event_25_04_03_015:
I'll get up as many times as it takes
and hit you with a "hero's strike"!
theater_event_25_04_03_016:
Eyes that refuse to die... Do you know the
insolence of defying the strong? Interesting.
I can see the path you've walked.
theater_event_25_04_03_017:
It seems you've survived more baptisms of fire
and climbed more walls than I'd expected.
theater_event_25_04_03_018: (...Huh? Why... is she smiling like that...?)
theater_event_25_04_03_019:
And... the sound of a "bell," is it?
..................It's laughable, Meteria.
theater_event_25_04_03_020:
But—you're still far from overturning
the "End."
theater_event_25_04_03_023:
That's... a pillar of light from a god being
sent back...? Then it's going just like
I was told...!
theater_event_25_04_03_024:
Time's up. Playtime is over.
...If you cannot stop me, you will perish here.
theater_event_25_04_03_027:
(Mr. Gareth! And that magic just now...
Ms. Riveria!)
theater_event_25_04_03_028:
By the look of you, you must be the Jester
Finn and the others mentioned! You held out
against that "monster" all on your own!
theater_event_25_04_03_030:
So you're alive—you of the Hera Familia,
the strongest goddess's familia!!
theater_event_25_04_03_032:
(The "Calamity of Talent" Ms. Ryu told me
about... So it really is her...!)
theater_event_25_04_03_033:
...More noise.
And my interest has waned.
theater_event_25_04_03_035:
"Absolute Evil" has summoned me as well.
That's enough for tonight.
theater_event_25_04_03_037:
A prophecy: you and I will never meet again.
I have DECIDED so.
theater_event_25_04_03_039:
A tyrant as ever... Crushing or leaving,
she decides it like a whim of the wind.
theater_event_25_04_03_040:
Alfia appearing on top of Zald is nothing but
bad news... but we can't dwell on it alone.
Orario is still a living hell.
theater_event_25_04_03_041:
I don't know what you're after... but if
you're no enemy, will you work with us,
Jester?
theater_event_25_04_03_042:
We want to save every life we can.
We know nothing of each other... but please,
lend us your strength.
theater_event_25_04_04_001: Drop the knife! You mustn't fight!
theater_event_25_04_04_002:
Don't listen to grown-ups who put
a weapon in the hands of a kid like you!
theater_event_25_04_04_003:
I won't hurt you, okay?
Come on, over here—
theater_event_25_04_04_005: Please... let me see my mommy and daddy...
theater_event_25_04_04_008:
(That's a shame... there was so much more
I wanted to do... and I don't want to say
goodbye to Ryu and the others...)
theater_event_25_04_04_009: (I wonder... if that little girl made it...)
theater_event_25_04_04_010:
(It's cold... so cold. My body, my heart,
they're freezing. Am I... just going to—)
theater_event_25_04_04_011:
—Okay.
I'll keep it forever, your present!
theater_event_25_04_04_012:
(—......Huh?
Why am I thinking of that, right now...?)
theater_event_25_04_04_013: So... we'll meet again, right, AL?!
theater_event_25_04_04_015:
(That name... the one I've been searching for,
the one that matters so much...)
theater_event_25_04_04_016: (It's warm. The cold is fading. But—wait!)
theater_event_25_04_04_017:
(Let me see his face!
I don't want to forget anymore!
I want to see him again!!)
theater_event_25_04_04_024:
Whoa?! R-Ryu?
A big warm hug from YOU?! What's gotten into you?!
theater_event_25_04_04_025: Don't you joke with me! Don't you... dare...!
theater_event_25_04_04_028:
I was going to give you a burning hug and go
"Ardee! You're alive! Woohoo, we win!!"
...but she beat me to it.
theater_event_25_04_04_029: Don't do it even if she hadn't, idiot.
theater_event_25_04_04_030:
Pulling through after all that... Just what
kind of miracle happened, honestly?
theater_event_25_04_04_033:
You got caught in a "suicide bombing"
set up by the Evilus... You were dying,
so we brought you here.
theater_event_25_04_04_034:
Everyone thought you were done for. And yet,
here you are... .........You're such a
troublesome little sister.
theater_event_25_04_04_035:
Sis... sorry I made you worry.
Thank you...
theater_event_25_04_04_037:
...Died instantly.
Unlike you, nothing was left of her.
theater_event_25_04_04_039:
Forget that—Ardee, how the hell are you alive?
Like Shakti said, that bomb was strong enough
that there's no way you should've made it.
theater_event_25_04_04_040:
...Sorry, I don't really know either. I don't
remember much. Everything went dark like in
a dream, then it suddenly got warm... Ah!
theater_event_25_04_04_042:
I-it's right here... so please calm down.
We only took it off to treat you.
theater_event_25_04_04_043:
It's broken... but thank goodness...!
It's still here! The precious gift
AL gave me—
theater_event_25_04_04_045:
Al... Al! That's right, Al!!
The boy who freeloaded at our home!
theater_event_25_04_04_046:
I remember everything that happened, but
I just couldn't remember him! So why now,
all of a sudden...?!
theater_event_25_04_04_047:
Could it be...
he's COME BACK?
theater_event_25_04_04_051:
How could I forget you?!
I wished so hard that I could
"see you again"!!
theater_event_25_04_04_052:
Did you save me?
Did this necklace save me—?!
theater_event_25_04_04_053:

theater_event_25_04_11_035:
"Then what, pray tell, is your justice?"
That god would likely engage in such
a dialogue.
theater_event_25_04_11_036:
But it's not to my taste.
What I want to do is something else.
theater_event_25_04_11_038:
Zald, the "Gluttony"... That's what they
called me.
theater_event_25_04_11_039:
Once the strongest follower of Zeus...
Does that ring a bell?
theater_event_25_04_11_041:
I've heard about you from Alfia.
You're going to play with me—"Bell Cranel."
theater_event_25_04_12_001:
(Zald, the "Gluttony"...! And of the strongest
familia, Zeus's! There's so much I don't know!
But I know this much!)
theater_event_25_04_12_002:
(He's STRONG!! As strong as that Alfia woman!
Take my eyes off him for an instant and he'll
crush me in the blink of an eye...!)
theater_event_25_04_12_003:
Fear, dread, panic... but a fierce will to fight
painting over it all. Good state—"flavor." Rich
enough to please this glutton's tongue.
theater_event_25_04_12_004:
(He sees right through me?! No... he can SMELL it!
I'm scared!! He's way too much of an "unknown"!
But I have no choice—!)
theater_event_25_04_12_005: —But I didn't come here to devour my prey.
theater_event_25_04_12_007:
I told you. You're going to "play with me."
Follow me.
theater_event_25_04_12_008:
That knife from earlier—fine weapon. Interesting,
too. Treat it well. A weapon is half
an adventurer.
theater_event_25_04_12_010:
How old are you? ...Fourteen? Too skinny. You're
not an elf. Eat more meat, all you can. How do
you expect to hold the vanguard like that?
theater_event_25_04_12_012:
(What is this... Why does this feel like getting
cornered by some uncle at a family gathering...)
theater_event_25_04_12_013:
(Well, I don't have any relatives, so I wouldn't
really know... but this is so weird...)
theater_event_25_04_12_016:
U... um? What exactly are you doing?
Z.........Mr. Zald?
theater_event_25_04_12_019:
A-a rock...? Are you going to bludgeon
me to death with it...?
theater_event_25_04_12_020:
What're you talking about?
You're a violent one. Adventurers, I swear.
theater_event_25_04_12_021: (Says the guy wearing a walking arsenal...)
theater_event_25_04_12_027: Don't go flying off on your own! Catch it properly!!
theater_event_25_04_12_029:
Now, it's your turn.
Throw it, Bell Cranel!
theater_event_25_04_12_030:
The rock you threw got blown to smithereens,
Mr. Zald!?
theater_event_25_04_12_031:
Quit your yapping!
Throwing back and forth is what makes "catch"!
Come at me with everything you've got!!
theater_event_25_04_12_032:
I have no idea what's going on...!
No idea, but... h-HYAAAAAAAAAAH!!
theater_event_25_04_12_035:
WHAAAAAAAAT?!
I threw it for real?! I'm Level 5, you know!!
theater_event_25_04_12_036:
Level 5, my foot, you fledgling.
Not enough killing intent! When you throw,
you do it—LIKE THISSSS!!!
theater_event_25_04_12_039:
I told you to put your hips into it!
UORAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
theater_event_25_04_13_003:
You know, I get the feeling this "catch"
the gods told me about was a little different.
theater_event_25_04_13_005:
Oh well.
I'm hungry. Let's eat.
theater_event_25_04_13_007:
Seriously, what's going on...? None of this
makes sense... And he just helped himself
to an empty house...
theater_event_25_04_13_010: D-did you make all of this, Mr. Zald?!
theater_event_25_04_13_011:
Ideally, I'd have spent a few days on prep,
but it can't be helped. It's makeshift, but
it should be edible.
theater_event_25_04_13_012:
THIS is makeshift...?!
It's like a concept I've never heard of...!
theater_event_25_04_13_013:
To master "eating anything," you need a taste
of "fine dining" too. That's all. ...Food isn't
for staring at. Hurry up and eat.
theater_event_25_04_13_014:
.........Okay.
Then... thank you for the food.
theater_event_25_04_13_016:
It's delicious!!
It's really, really good, Mr. Zald!!
theater_event_25_04_13_017:
Spare me the flattery. Just eat.
A kid's job is to eat his fill and grow big.
theater_event_25_04_13_019:
It really is delicious!
How do you even make food like this?!
theater_event_25_04_13_020:
The meat, the vegetables, the soup!
If only I could treat my goddess to something
this good...!
theater_event_25_04_13_024:
Ah, no...
I was just wondering if you're not eating,
Mr. Zald...
theater_event_25_04_13_025:
I'll eat on my own time. Don't go worrying about
me, you brat. Here, there's seconds.
theater_event_25_04_13_027:
(Mr. Zald keeps watching me... But it doesn't
feel bad. It feels warm, kind of...)
theater_event_25_04_13_028: (Why is he looking at me like that...?)
theater_event_25_04_13_029:
...You look alike. Your eyes especially—
spitting image.
theater_event_25_04_13_031:
...I said you remind me of a man I knew.
Opposite personality, though. Comparing you
would be an insult to you.
theater_event_25_04_13_032:
(Why's he suddenly trashing someone
I've never met...?)
theater_event_25_04_13_033:
...Listen. Generally, I don't care what anyone
does. Live how you like, die how you like.
I don't butt into how people live.
theater_event_25_04_13_034:
But there's one thing I have to tell you.
My advice is rare. Carve it into your heart.
Don't you forget it.
theater_event_25_04_13_037: Do what you want, but ALWAYS use protection.
theater_event_25_04_13_039:
I'm dead serious. Dead. Get that part right,
no matter what. It's for her sake too.
Don't confuse what real kindness is.
theater_event_25_04_13_040:
W-wait, hold on a second!
What on earth are we talking about?!
theater_event_25_04_13_043:
You've gotta get that stuff right! It causes
trouble for everyone around you, you hear?!
It's a real nightmare!!!
theater_event_25_04_13_044:
The terror when I found out that guy had gone
and made a kid...! Hera's lot come to kill me
even in my dreams, you know?!
theater_event_25_04_13_045:
Familia are bound by blood, sharing one fate?
Who cares!!! Me and Pahl were always the ones
stuck cleaning up his messes anyway...!
theater_event_25_04_13_046:
What are you even saying...?!
Why are you telling ME this?!
theater_event_25_04_13_047:
Who else would I tell, you damn brat?!
You look like the type to get eaten, not do
the eating, so I'm worried about you!
theater_event_25_04_13_048:
I have no idea what you're trying to say
anymore, Mr. Zald!!!
theater_event_25_04_13_049:
Shut up and listen!! No matter how cocky a man
gets, in the end he's no match for a strong
woman! By the time you notice, it's too late!
theater_event_25_04_13_050:
Protect yourself—not for others, for yourself!
A man who can't do that has no right to be
a "hero"! NOOOOOOOOO RIGHT AT ALL!!!
